comparison.objective: Seat a 2.5-inch SSD in a tool-less drive carrier; not separate mixed loose bodies.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a sprung rail open while aligning four pins with drive holes and seating a rigid plate.
comparison.success_condition: All pins engaged, rail closed, drive correctly oriented and flat, stable for 1 s. Earlier and later versions differ on whether prior misorientation invalidates success.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained insertion into spring-loaded locating pins, not size-selective sifting.
